data.summary:
Senior Network Engineer with over 5 years of experience designing, deploying, and maintaining
large-scale ISP and enterprise networks. Proven expertise in routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, ISIS,
MPLS), switching (VLAN, STP, RSTP, EtherChannel), and multi-vendor environments (Cisco,
Nokia, Huawei, MikroTik). Skilled in firewall management (Palo Alto, Fortinet), network automation
using Python, and incident management.
< > Skills
Routing: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIP, ISIS, MPLS, LOP, VPN
Switching: VLANs, VTP, STP, PVST, RSTP, MSTP
Redundancy: HSRP, VRRP, SRRP, EtherChannel
Multi-Vendor: Cisco (ISR, Catalyst), Nokia (7750 SR,IXR), Huawei, MikroTik
Firewalls: Palo Alto, Fortinet (NAT/PAT, IPsec, SSL, Security Policies, HA)
Automation: Python scripting, network automation
Networking Services: DHCP, PPPoE, RADIUS, TACACS+, DNS
Monitoring & Troubleshooting: SolarWinds, The Dude

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Senior Network Engineer STL Digital PVT LTD, Hyderabad
Dec 2025 - Present
Track network utilization, traffic patterns, and uptime using SolarWinds to ensure optimal
network health
Configure and manage external BGP (eBGP) peering policies on edge routers, implementing
prefix-lists and AS-Path prepending.
Demonstrate technical versatility by seamlessly deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting
network infrastructure across multi-vendor environments (Nokia, Cisco, Huawei).
Managed VLANs, Spanning Tree Protocol (STP/RSTP), and EtherChannel (LACP) across
access and distribution layers to optimize LAN performance.
Senior Network Engineer Atria Convergence Technologies LTD, Hyderabad
Sep 2022 - Dec 2025
Monitored vital health parameters (CPU utilization, interface drops, memory thresholds) of
distributed Cisco ISR/Catalyst switches and Nokia SR OS platforms using SolarWinds. • Established BGP peering with service providers, managed traffic flow, added routes, and
announced prefixes to enhance customer browsing performance.
Designed and deployed IPsec VPN tunnels across Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls for
secure multi-site connectivity and DM/ application access.
Provisioned, configured, and staged Cisco ISR (4000/1000 series) routers and Cisco Catalyst
(9000/3850 series) switches for branch deployments.
Maintained robust security architectures by establishing IPsec VPN tunnels and managing complex NAT policies (Source NAT/PAT, Destination NAT) using Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls.
Developed Python scripts to automate daily repetitive tasks and streamline network
configurations, reducing human provisioning errors
Utilized Palo Alto Monitor Logs and Traffic Log Viewer to analyze policy drops, verify rule
matching, and resolve user technical/no-browsing complaints.
Provided 24/7 incident response support, driving ticket resolution for Huawei and Nokia
network infrastructure.
Network Engineer GTPL Hathway PVT LTD, Hyderabad
Jun 2021 - Sep 2022
Conducted daily monitoring and real-time troubleshooting on Cisco and MikroTik devices using
The Dude monitoring tool.
Deployed and configured Cisco Catalyst 9300/3850/2950/2960 Series switches, managing
VLANs and optimizing loop-free topologies with RSTP and MSTP
Served as a core member of the Network Operations team, providing 24/7 support to monitor,
investigate, and resolve LAN/WA N routing and stability issues.
'9' Education
B.Tech Mechanical Engineering - KKR & KSR Institute of Technology and Sciences, JNTU
Kakinada (2016-2019)
Diploma Mechanical Engineering - GVMP College, SBTET (2013-2016)
SSC - Saraswathi High School, Prakasam (2013)
